scholarships.title: Poland My First Choice NAWA
scholarships.official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)

existing.description: The Poland My First Choice NAWA programme encourages young talented people from a list of eligible countries to study at Polish university-type higher education institutions, awarding a scholarship for the statutory period of full-time second-cycle studies at academic institutions, both public and non-public, supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education, and in addition providing an exemption from tuition fees at public universities. Applicants choose their university and field of study independently from the offer of universities listed in the call for applications, and NAWA explicitly does not act as an intermediary in admission. The programme does not cover fields of study offered only by institutions supervised by other ministries. Eligibility is by citizenship of one of the listed countries and territories.
eligibility: Citizenship of one of the listed countries and territories (45 in total on the page read)
Applying to full-time second-cycle studies at an academic HEI supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education
Both public and non-public academic HEIs are eligible as study venues, though the tuition exemption applies only at public universities
The field of study must not be offered only by HEIs supervised by other ministries
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizens of one of the listed countries and territories: Australia, Finland, Japan, Republic of Korea, Austria, France, Latvia, Romania, Belgium, Germany, Liechtenstein, Singapore, Bulgaria, Great Britain, Lithuania, Slovakia, Canada, Greece, Luxembourg, Slovenia, Chile, Hong Kong SAR, Macau SAR, Spain, Croatia, Hungary, Malta, Sweden, Cyprus, Iceland, Netherlands, Switzerland, Czech Republic, Ireland, New Zealand, Taiwan, Denmark, Israel, Norway, United States of America, Estonia, Italy, Portugal and Uruguay. Applicants must be seeking full-time second-cycle studies at an academic higher education institution supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education. Fields offered only by institutions supervised by other ministries are excluded.
benefits: Scholarship covering the statutory period of full-time second-cycle studies
Tuition fee exemption at public universities
Access to any eligible Polish university and field listed in the call
Independent choice of university and field of study
coverage: Scholarship for the statutory period of full-time second-cycle studies
Exemption from tuition fees at public universities
Studies at both public and non-public academic higher education institutions
requirements: Hold citizenship of one of the listed eligible countries or territories
Apply to a full-time second-cycle programme at an academic HEI supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education
Apply independently to the university of your choice, separately from the NAWA application
Choose from the offer of universities and fields listed in the call for applications
Note that fields offered only by HEIs supervised by other ministries are not covered
documents: Application submitted through the NAWA system
Academic certificates for the level applied for, as required by the call
Language certificate as required by the chosen university
Documents listed in the current call for applications
existing.english_requirement: Not stated on the programme page read; language requirements follow the chosen university's rules and are set out in the call for applications.
application_method: Check that your citizenship is on the eligible list
Choose a university and field from the offer published in the call for applications
Apply for admission directly at the university, independently of NAWA
Submit the scholarship application through the NAWA system before the deadline in the call
Complete the university's own admission process, including any language or entry requirements
existing.selection_notes: Because NAWA does not act as an intermediary in admission, applicants face two separate processes: the university's admission decision and the NAWA scholarship decision. Places are limited per university and field as set out in the call, so early application at the chosen institution matters.
existing.best_fit: Young applicants from any of the 45 listed developed and emerging countries who hold or are completing a first degree and want a full-time master's programme at a Polish academic HEI, and who are prepared to handle university admission separately from the scholarship application.
existing.notes: The scholarship amount and any travel allowance are set out in the call for applications, which could not be read: the stored call-for-applications URL returns HTTP 404 and the amounts were not published on the programme page. funding_amount is therefore left null rather than guessed.
existing.application_period: One call per academic year, published on NAWA's Poland My First Choice programme page. The stored call-for-applications URL for this programme returns HTTP 404 on 2026-10-04, so no current deadline could be read.
